title: Kissed Buttery Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Algerian dish featuring chicken cooked in a rich and aromatic sauce, perfect for a sick day, this recipe is low in sodium and features a unique blue food coloring, all wrapped up in a papillote for a fun twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the melted butter, blue food coloring, paprika, cumin, coriander, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the butter mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Cover the pot with a piece of parchment paper, creating a papillote, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top.
Serve the chicken and sauce hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
